an7.5:1.1: V. Satt' imāni bhikkhave dhanāni. Katamāni satta? Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave satta dhanānī ti.
an7.5:2.1: Saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hiri ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ sutadhanañ ca cāgo ca paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.
an7.5:3.1: Yassa ete dhanā atthi itthiyā purisassa vā. adaliddo ti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
an7.5:4.1: Tasmā saddhañ ca sīlañ ca pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ anuyuñjetha medhāvī saraṃ buddhānasāsanan ti.
